text:
Maya C: Quick heads-up — planning a hands-on refapp tutorial + benchmark launch for the OSS refapp. Target window: 3–4 weeks. Need three things: launch post (marketing), benchmark narrative (technical + hero numbers), 60m webinar (dev walkthrough + Q&A), and an inbound lead routing plan. Who can own each?
Sam G: I'll take the launch post + copy. Thinking angle: "how we made the refapp 3x cheaper on avg" — tie to Optimize recommendations. :rocket:
Liam R: I can own the benchmark narrative — will run the p99 latency / cost-per-token experiments across 3 model variants. Need a test harness from eng-ml. ETA 7 days for initial numbers.
Ana P: I'll coordinate the webinar logistics (date, registration page, speaker ops) and inbound routing (HubSpot). Propose Wed 4/22 10am PT. Is that okay for engineers?
Jules (devrel): Devrel can run the hands-on portion and live demo. I'll prepare a short lab and a one-click deploy snippet. Also want a short tutorial video (5–7m) clipped from the webinar.
Sam G: Copy question — do we lead with cost savings or latency? For dev audience, trust + reproducible numbers matter. Maybe headline: "Scale inference for less: real refapp benchmarks + quickstart".
Maya C: Lean technical first, then call out cost/latency in bullets. Marketing can push paid socials after we have the benchmark gifs and key stat cards.
Liam R: Need these from eng-ml: exact infra config (GPU types, quantization flags), batch sizes, business-hour traffic profile. @DevRel Bot can you fetch recent harness results and attach link?
DevRel Bot: Attached — latest harness run: https://internal.redwood/results/bench-2026-03-10 — summary: 98th pctl latency 120ms (small model), cost/token: $0.0009.
Jules (devrel): For the hands-on lab I'll add a script:
```
# quick deploy
rcli deploy --refapp tutorial --region us-west1 --gpu a100 --quantize q4_0
rcli run --test --profile=bench-small
```
Sam G: Draft timeline: 1) Benchmark complete + gifs (week 1), 2) Draft post + review (week 2), 3) Webinar prep + recording (week 3), 4) Launch + socials (week 4). Assign owners in doc.
Ana P: Inbound mapping: registration -> HubSpot -> tag "refapp-launch" -> assign leads to devrel & sales based on company size. I'll build a short form with checkbox for "pilot interest".
Maya C: Action items: Sam (post), Liam (bench), Ana (webinar + routing), Jules (lab + demo). Please update the shared doc: https://docs.redwood/marketing/refapp-launch (edit rights: marketing, devrel, eng-ml). I'll schedule a 30m sync for Friday to check progress. :calendar:
Sam G: Noted. I'll drop a draft by Tue.
Liam R: Starting bench runs today. Will ping when p95/p99 stable.
Ana P: I'll reserve the webinar slot and set up the registration page by EOD.
Jules (devrel): Will prepare the one-click demo and short tutorial clip. Also want a `/try` playground snippet for the post.
Maya C: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping here. Thanks :heart:
